primaryDialogs.confirmDescription: Marks the stay as confirmed and ready for arrival. Guest and money details should already be complete.
primaryDialogs.checkInEarlyDescription: Scheduled stay is {{checkIn}} → {{checkOut}} (property local). Check-in date stays the same unless you edit the stay.
primaryDialogs.checkInDescription: Sets status to In-house. You can still collect a balance due afterward.
primaryDialogs.checkOutUnpaidDescription: Ends the stay. Booked dates stay as history — use Collect afterward if they still owe. OTAs pick up availability from the unit’s iCal feed (may lag).
primaryDialogs.checkOutPaidDescription: Ends the stay. Booked dates stay as history unless you edited them first. OTAs pick up availability from the unit’s iCal feed (may lag).
primaryDialogs.checkOutUtilitiesDue: Record this stay's final meter reading and maintenance before checkout — the final Total won't include last month's utilities.
